paragraphs: Rav Pappa bar Hanan, of Bei Tzelohit Kelohit [both forms retained]. Before Shimi bar Ashi: Ketubbot 40b. He was before Rav Yosef (I do not know whence this is derived). He was Rava's scribe: Bava Batra 153a, ‘Rav Pappa bar Rav Hanan, Rava's scribe.’
